text.pages_rule: 12n-1 supply (12n-1); packed 108 content pages, no blank padding (count is already a multiple of 12)
text.page_fit_note: master 203.2 x 292.1 mm sits 12.80 mm inside the trim on the sides and -13.10 mm top and bottom; its edges are flat (worst step 0/255) so the margin continues them invisibly -- no rescaling
text.content_shift_note: content moved 3.7 mm toward the outer edge and 0.5 mm down: closest live text is now 21.0 mm off the gutter (was 17.3), 18.4 mm from the outer trim (was 22.1) and 6.0 mm from the top trim (their rules: 20 mm gutter, 5 mm trim; tightest page 9, 10.9 mm off the gutter)
text.outline_note: outlined glyphs, text re-laid invisibly (3215 spans)
text.note: kept RGB: the master sets its text in fonts that cannot be embedded (3 Type 3 glyph programs); the pack outlines those glyphs so BookVault's font check passes, and their preflight converts the RGB (guide p.6)

checks.name: Text file page size is 222 x 285 mm
checks.detail: 222.00 x 285.00 mm = 216 x 279 mm trim plus 3 mm bleed (their text template is 222 x 285)

checks.name: Bleed is 3 mm on all four edges
checks.detail: guide p.5 requires 3 mm; media extends 3 mm past the trim on every side

checks.name: Bleed continues the page edge
checks.detail: no point across the cut lines puts a whitish colour against a coloured one (3888 points checked), so no white nick can print

checks.name: Page artwork survives assembly
checks.detail: sampled interior pages carry the master's artwork

checks.name: Bleed seam matches the artwork
checks.detail: the smear meets the page with no visible step in the bleed

checks.name: Live text clears their 20 mm gutter
checks.detail: closest live text is 21.2 mm off the gutter (page 1); guide p.3 asks for 20 mm

checks.name: Live text clears their 5 mm trim safety
checks.detail: closest live text is 3.9 mm from the top edge (page 7); their template draws a 5 mm safety line

checks.name: Single pages, portrait
checks.detail: 108 single pages, portrait, all 222.0 mm wide

checks.name: Page count is 12n-1
checks.detail: 108 pages (108 of book); guide p.5: supply one less than a divisible of 12, the production barcode is added to the last page

checks.name: Last page is clear for their barcode
checks.detail: the final page is blank, so the barcode they add lands on nothing

checks.name: Cover pages stripped from the interior
checks.detail: the front cover and the back cover are removed: they belong in the cover file, and leaving them in prints the cover twice

checks.name: All fonts embedded
checks.detail: every font is embedded: the book's glyphs are outlined as the vector artwork they always were, and the one font left -- the invisible, searchable text layer -- is embedded (guide p.3)

checks.name: No Type 3 glyph-program fonts
checks.detail: none: the Type 3 glyph programs this book was set in are now vector artwork in the page itself (guide p.3)

checks.name: Transparency flattened
checks.detail: 30 pages still carry it (page 5: image soft mask); Ghostscript's flattening pass ran and left it in place, so it has to be cleared before a print run (guide p.3)

checks.name: Images at 300 DPI or better
checks.detail: 101 below 300 DPI, e.g. page 2: 150 DPI; page 4: 150 DPI; page 5: 150 DPI

checks.name: Master page box fitted to their trim
checks.detail: master 203.2 x 292.1 mm sits 12.80 mm inside the trim on the sides and -13.10 mm top and bottom; its edges are flat (worst step 0/255) so the margin continues them invisibly -- no rescaling

checks.name: Artwork covers the printed area
checks.detail: 108 pages carry a soft continuation of the page edge up to 2.7 mm inside the trim: this master is smaller than the trim and cannot be enlarged without losing its gutter margin (see the page-size line above) -- re-export it at 216 x 279 mm to print artwork to the cut

checks.name: Binding-edge clearance
checks.detail: closest text is 21.2 mm from the left edge on page 1; guide p.3 asks for 20 mm on the gutter, their template prints 17 mm

checks.name: No trim or bleed marks
checks.detail: none are drawn, and the media box is exactly trim + bleed (222.00 x 285.00 mm), leaving no room for any

checks.name: Text file is PDF/X-1a:2001 with CMYK
checks.detail: kept RGB: the master sets its text in fonts that cannot be embedded (3 Type 3 glyph programs); the pack outlines those glyphs so BookVault's font check passes, and their preflight converts the RGB (guide p.6)

checks.name: Cover file is a perfect-bound spread
checks.detail: 445.01 x 284.99 mm = back 216 + spine 7 + front 216 + 3 mm bleed, by their p.18 formula

checks.name: Barcode area clear on the back cover
checks.detail: the 38 x 25 mm box their template reserves (6.4 mm in from the right trim, 6.4 mm up) is empty; a barcode is required printing outside the UK

checks.name: Spine width taken from their sizing calculator
checks.detail: built at 7 mm from 108 pages x 0.056 mm per page, rounded up (guide p.18). Run home > help > sizing calculator for the real paper and rebuild with --spine-mm <mm>
